Congress alleges corruption in MP CM's land deals; CM's office denies

The Congress party has accused Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav and his family of corruption following a media report detailing significant land acquisitions in Ujjain. The opposition party alleges an 'engine of loot' and has demanded the Chief Minister's resignation and an independent probe. The Chief Minister's office has reportedly rejected the report.
